name: demo_enriched_article
description: Proper JVS type for enriched news articles. Inherits sysobject (id: core_id, title/body/description: core_mls, times: core_dates) so every mls field gets the full enrichment surface — clean, segmented, pos, segmented_ner — populated by the JVS enrichment engine when it runs. Adds article-specific fields (country, category, tags, source_url, keywords) on top.
